messages.author: 0f2b08c63f98d13b
messages.subject: occu vs. pcount
parts:
Hi,

I am completely new to unmarked so forgive me if this question is a bit basic!

I have been working on figuring out the occupancy of leopards using camera trap data. I am wondering is it legitimate to compare the AICs of pcount & occu models in order to determine support for a link between occupancy and detection? The AIC values for my occu models are much lower than the pcount versions.

Thanks,

Leanne

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] occu vs. pcount
parts:
hi Leanna,
 no you should never compare AIC across models whenever the data change. Different data , or more data, or less data, changes AIC.
regards
andy

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] occu vs. pcount

hi Leanna,
 the occupancy models are for presence/absence data where as the pcount models are for counts data so they do not operate on the same data
regards
andy
